home.title: Inner Development Goals for everyday teaching
home.lead: 23 skills on flip cards: the official IDG framework on the front, concrete prompts for you, your class and your lessons on the back — ready in minutes.
home.dimensionsLead: Pick a dimension or draw a random card for class council and morning circle.

skills.title: All skills
skills.lead: Filter by dimension or browse the full deck.

card.flipHint: Tap or press Enter to flip the card

about.title: About this app
about.whatBody: The Inner Development Goals (IDG) describe inner capacities that people and societies need to shape sustainable development. Five dimensions, 23 skills — a framework that connects being and doing.
howSteps: Draw a card or choose a dimension.
Flip: prompts for you, the class and the lesson.
Take one idea into your next lesson — that is enough.
about.inspired: This work is inspired by the Inner Development Goals. Learn more at
about.frameworkNote: The IDG Framework (dimension names, skill names and official descriptions) is unchanged. Classroom prompts on the card backs are original material for this app.
about.nonCommercial: Non-commercial educational use. Not an official product of the Inner Development Goals Foundation.
about.languageLead: The UI is translation-ready. German is the default; English is included.
about.brandBody: Colors and dimension symbolism follow the IDG Brandguide. This app uses the «Inspired by IDG» treatment and not the Foundation’s restricted main logo as an official mark.

install.title: Install the app
install.body: Add IDG in the Classroom to your home screen — cards work offline too.
install.iosHint: On iPhone: Share → «Add to Home Screen»

footer.inspiredText: This work is inspired by the Inner Development Goals. Learn more at
footer.frameworkUnchanged: The IDG Framework itself is unchanged.
